title: Bigger, better, different
description: Compare things, and say what should happen.
grammarNote: Más and menos compare. The superlative adds -ísimo: el más grande, la más pequeña.

items.note: More. It also means most. It takes an accent in a question.
Better. It has no comparative form: es mejor, es el mejor.
Worse. Like mejor, it never changes.
Higher, superior. It also means better.
Lower, inferior. It also means worse.
Main, most important. It does not change for a feminine noun.
Special. It does not change for a feminine noun.
Strong. It does not change for a feminine noun.
Soft, smooth. It does not change for a feminine noun.
